newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain to continue liberalisation measures - Rato.
newsitem.headline: Spain to continue liberalisation measures - Rato.

text.p: Spanish Economy Minister Rodrigo Rato said on Thursday the government would continue its liberalisation policies, especially in the labour market and in the public sector.

"Right now strengthening structural reforms is vital...the government will continue to reform the labour market, with the objective of more stable jobs through a reduction in non-wage labour costs and a reform of the public sector," Rato said in a speech at a yearly seminar of saving banks.
Of Spanish government more than one year in power, he said that until now "we approved the right measures and we must go ahead in the same direction."
But he also gave a favourable evaluation of the steps made so far by the Spanish economy.
"The Spanish economy is now facing a period of stability and growth which is exactly what we have wanted 14 months ago."
Steady growth at three percent, more than half a point higher than other (European countries) but a similar inflation level is sustainable medium term, he said.
